epics.title: Anti-Spoiler Prompt Hardening & Pre-Filtering Engine (Defect DEF-005)
epics.description: Hardens the AssessmentAgent prompt architecture with structured misconception reasoning templates and applies deterministic pre-filtering (`sanitize_spec_misconceptions`) before ContextBus validation to eliminate repair-loop quarantine stalls.
acceptance_criteria: 100% of generated distractors pass zero-spoiler regex before repair escalation.
Zero quarantine activations across 10 consecutive chapter synthesis runs.
Diagnostic feedback clearly explains conceptual error without revealing answer or formula calculation.

epics.title: Dual-Repository GitOps Synchronization & Release Gate Promotion (Defect DEF-002)
epics.stream: Stream 7: Autonomous Multi-Agent Orchestration & Control Plane
epics.description: Standardizes working-tree hygiene across both root (`NGO AI LLM`) and sub-repo (`Aasha-AI`). Enforces atomic synchronization checks in `scripts/sync_and_push_all_autonomous_cycles.mjs` before executing Gate 6 release promotions.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-commit and pre-push hooks verify clean status across both root and sub-repo.
Zero untracked scratch artifacts staged during automated cycles.
Automated release promotion to trunk (`origin/master` and `origin/main`) completes via `-s ours` DAG reconciliation without tree divergence.

epics.title: 9Router AI Gateway Resilient Background Supervisor (Defect DEF-001)
epics.stream: Stream 7: Autonomous Multi-Agent Orchestration & Control Plane
epics.description: Embeds a lightweight process supervisor inside the root orchestrator CLI to detect dormant 9Router gateway instances on port 20128 and automatically launch `start_9router_hidden.ps1` with detached process stdio.
acceptance_criteria: Port 20128 automatically becomes responsive within 2 seconds of invoking `npm start` or `npm run aasha:loop`.
Subagent tasks consistently utilize local gateway caching without 429 backoff stalls.
Resident memory footprint strictly remains < 30 MB RAM.

epics.title: Asset Pipeline Optimization & 1.0 MB Chapter Packaging Ceiling (Defect DEF-006)
epics.stream: Stream 6: Single-File HTML5 Compiler & Offline Edge Runtime
epics.description: Implements automated Pillow JPEG/WebP downsampling (max width 1000px, quality 80) for all raster assets in `v6_compiler.ts`, compressing asset-heavy chapters (such as Fractions from 6.47 MB to < 1.0 MB) while preserving 100% offline self-containment.
acceptance_criteria: All compiled standalone chapter HTML files measure <= 1,048,576 bytes (1.0 MB) without external network dependencies.
Headless Chrome CDP audits verify zero visual degradation on high-DPI viewports.
DOM parse time on 1GB RAM budget mobile devices drops by > 70%.

epics.title: LaTeX AST Math Insulator & Multi-Line Formula Shielding (Defect DEF-004)
epics.stream: Stream 5: Indic Language Layer Engine (LLE) & Bilingual Substrate
epics.description: Upgrades `math_insulator.ts` from heuristic regex replacements to a formal AST-based LaTeX token parser, guaranteeing zero transliteration collision on complex fractions, matrices, and algebraic formulas.
acceptance_criteria: Zero `math-rt` collisions across all NCERT Class 8-10 Mathematics chapters.
Full support for nested LaTeX fractions, square roots, and variable groupings.
100/100 score maintained on L-Truth Benchmark Rule 4 (Math Insulation Integrity).

epics.title: Dual SQLite Telemetry Event Sync Daemon (Defect DEF-008)
epics.stream: Stream 8: Multi-Tier Persistent Memory & Local State Hierarchy
epics.description: Implements an automated bi-directional event sync bridge between root `aasha_operational.db` and sub-repo `offline_sync.db`, maintaining real-time parity of the evidence ledger and learner progress records.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence ledger updates committed in sub-repo tests appear in root queries in < 5ms.
Zero locking errors on concurrent SQLite transactions.
Zero cloud credential requirements (Method B strictly preserved).

epics.title: Multilingual Indic Expansion Substrate (Bengali, Tamil, Telugu)
epics.stream: Stream 5: Indic Language Layer Engine (LLE) & Bilingual Substrate
epics.description: Expands the active LLE substrate from Hindi to include vetted local offline dictionaries and Devanagari/Indic phonetics for Bengali, Tamil, and Telugu regional school boards.

Offline WordMap modals render correctly in all target Indic scripts.
Zero runtime external API calls required for inlined Indic translations.
